```yaml
name: Claude Code Review

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      # Support both legacy and prefixed environment variable names
      DISABLE_GITHUB_REPORTER: ${{ secrets.DISABLE_GITHUB_REPORTER }}
      TUNIT_DISABLE_GITHUB_REPORTER: ${{ secrets.DISABLE_GITHUB_REPORTER }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '7.0.x'

      - name: Restore dependencies
        run: dotnet restore

      - name: Build
        run: dotnet build --configuration Release --no-restore

      - name: Run tests
        run: dotnet test --configuration Release --no-build --verbosity normal

      - name: Show reporter flag
        run: |
          echo "DISABLE_GITHUB_REPORTER=${{ env.DISABLE_GITHUB_REPORTER }}"
          echo "TUNIT_DISABLE_GITHUB_REPORTER=${{ env.TUNIT_DISABLE_GITHUB_REPORTER }}"
```
